Great little place
Jan 2019 • Couples
We stumbled across this restaurant which is on 2nd floor shared with a burger restaurant Relish and Sons.

We tried several dumplings and a couple of bao. The choice of options was good, not too overwhelming and it was all full of flavour.

You get 3pcs of each of the dumplings so it's good to try a few dishes. I can understand it may not be the cheapest place around, particularly for locals but we found it to be good value.

The restaurant has a really cosy vibe, interesting decor and the staff are very nice. We would recommend and would love to come back.

Very cool place, great food
Nov 2018 • Solo
This review is for the D.1 shop as it doesn't seem to have its own TripAdvisor yet. 

It was reasonably late when I went looking for something to eat so I wasn't sure what I'd have available. The logo looked fun & I like dumplings so I thought I'd give it a shot. I'm so glad I did!

It's at the top of the building up 3 floors with a narrow staircase as is so often the case in Vietnam. The place is decorated great & was playing a fun mix of 60's music (all instrumental) that sounded like it had been blended with auger & western (cowboy) music. 

The food was a little hard for me to work out ordering but the staff helped me out & it came out pretty quickly if in a slightly odd order. 

It was very tasty & had a great selection. The set menu was enough to satisfy & for a reasonable price, yes it's not street food price but it was still value as far as I'm concerned. 

I'd happily go there again

Tasty pricey dumplings
Aug 2018 • Family
If you already had tasty traditional dumplings elsewhere then you might be disappointed with this place. But there are a lot of mixed feelings I have about this place

1. Freshly made small dumplings the taste that you can’t get rid of. The downside is the quantity of dumplings made which is too less (2 pieces) perhaps 4 pieces could look great comparing to other oriental restaurants in town

2. Friendly staff and pretty quick serve makes it convenient 

3.The items could look pricey to some of us but worth of value despite the place being a bit small to fit in for very few people given fact that the location is thao dien

Overall tasty but pricey food items to go for. Perhaps on a slightly expensive if you are on a tight budget 

Go for it if you are just a starter in tasting oriental food

Asian fusion dumplings
Mar 2018 • Solo
The outlet i went to was along the street where sheraton hotel is. This was the third level above the burger joint. Loved the decor .chinois ... chinese oriental murals. With dim lights .... dumplings were of szechuan, thai sauces divided into fried or steamed versions. For steamed , i had the pork prawn dumpling in szechuan chili- this was whoping hot! Be careful! It bites the tongue! Dumpling skin was smooth. Worth a try but beware of the spice level. Next was the fried dumpling with duck red curry. Red curry was sprinkled on the outside. I wished more curry was drizZled or given as a dipping sauce.
